sampling.selection: Uniform row sampling without replacement from the full pinned release
sampling.interval_method: Approximate pointwise 95% Wilson score interval with finite-population variance correction, conditional on the stated denominator; SRS without replacement only. No uncertainty interval is assigned to census or original block-sample counts.

model_by_year.definition: Each cell supplies both within-year family share and joint year/family share of all rows.

findings: English input length was higher in the original sample: median 193 words versus 176 in the full release (178 in the row-random sample).
The full release has 83.54% single-user-message records; the original sample has 83.00%.
English source labels: 52.48% of the release versus 53.18% of the original sample (+0.70 percentage points).
The named template matches 6.42% of released rows versus 6.29% of original-sample rows. It does not verify a real group conversation.
The 120-input AI audit was not repeated or human-validated. Its relational labels do not estimate the whole release.
semantic_status: Existing AI labels only; no new semantic labeling or human validation in this statistical check.
